  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially after sentiment > 0.00).",
    "Adjust downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.00) and model shows upward bias.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if 3-5 consecutive forecast days exceed true outcome by >10%.",
    "Lower forecast for early days of new sentiment trend (e.g., first 3 days after sentiment shift).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is negative and price is trending down.",
    "Cap forecast at 10% below recent 5-day low if sentiment is negative and price is falling.",
    "Use sentiment as a multiplier for correction: if sentiment > 0.25, apply 10-15% downward adjustment to forecast."
